A recipe submission loops until the editors approve it:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Submit recipe"] --> B["Run format checks"]
    B --> C{"All checks pass?"}
    C -->|"No"| D["Author fixes and resubmits"]
    D --> B
    C -->|"Yes"| E["Editors read it"]
    E --> F{"Verdict?"}
    F -->|"Request changes"| G["Author revises"]
    G --> B
    F -->|"Approve"| H{"Two approvals?"}
    H -->|"No"| E
    H -->|"Yes":::focus --> I["Publish recipe"]
    I --> J["Tag for the newsletter"]

    classDef focus fill:#ffe08a,stroke:#b8860b,stroke-width:2px
```

Most recipes need one round of changes.
